target.query: from(bucket: "smokeping") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "host_uplink" and (r._field == "previous" or r._field == "interface" or r._field == "kind")) |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value") |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.previous) |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, text: "Uplink " + r.previous + " → " + (if r.interface == "" then "none" else r.interface + " (" + r.kind + ")"), tags: "uplink"}))

from(bucket: "smokeping") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "dns_resolver" and (r._field == "previous" or r._field == "owner")) |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time", "path"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value") |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.previous) |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, text: "Resolver via " + r.path + ": " + r.previous + " → " + r.owner, tags: "resolver"}))

title: Target Detail – every layer for one target
description: Pick a target and see everything measured for it: ICMP, the TCP handshake, HTTP/1.1, /2 and /3, and DNS when the target is a resolver. Targets pair by name across probes (Google, Google_h2, Google_tcp443; W_<service>_icmp, _tcp, _h1–_h3 for the DNS wizard). A layer the target has no probe for says "not measured".

list.name: target
list.label: Target
list.query:
import "regexp"
import "strings"
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
schema.tagValues(bucket: "smokeping", tag: "target", start: -7d, predicate: (r) => r._measurement == "latency" or r._measurement == "tcp_latency" or r._measurement == "http_latency" or r._measurement == "dns_latency") |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _value: regexp.replaceAllString(r: /(_h[123]|_tcp(443)?|_icmp)$/, v: r._value, t: "") })) |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with key: strings.toLower(v: r._value) })) |> group(columns: ["key"]) |> first() |> group() |> keep(columns: ["_value"]) |> sort()

panels.title: ${target} – what is measured, over the selected range
ICMP
panels.description: Ping (FPing): the network path, no application. "not measured": this target has no such probe (or it wrote nothing in the range).

targets.query: from(bucket:"smokeping") |> range(start:v.timeRangeStart, stop:v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn:(r)=> r._measurement == "latency" and r.target =~ /^(?i)${target:regex}(_h[123]|_tcp(443)?|_icmp)?$/ and r._field == "median") |> group(columns:["_measurement"]) |> median() |> map(fn:(r)=> ({ r with _value: r._value * 1000.0 })) |> set(key:"_field", value:"median") |> keep(columns:["_value","_field"])

from(bucket:"smokeping") |> range(start:v.timeRangeStart, stop:v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn:(r)=> r._measurement == "latency" and r.target =~ /^(?i)${target:regex}(_h[123]|_tcp(443)?|_icmp)?$/ and r._field == "loss") |> group(columns:["_measurement"]) |> mean() |> map(fn:(r)=> ({ r with _value: r._value * 100.0 })) |> set(key:"_field", value:"loss") |> keep(columns:["_value","_field"])
